correctness.rationale: Associativity with unit forces B_f(a,b)=f(ab), and f is recovered from B_f(1,-). On each active branch, the power block on x_i,...,x_i^(h_i-1) is anti-triangular with nonzero anti-diagonal c_{i,h_i}, giving invertible rank h_i-1. Eliminating the unit leaves a star-shaped residual matrix [[c,v^T],[v,0]] of rank 2 whenever v has a nonzero top coordinate, in any characteristic. Inactive branches are radical. Counting highest nonzero branch coefficient (q-1)q^(h_i-1), with q free unit coefficient, gives 1+(q-1)z+q z²(prod_i[1+(q-1)sum_{a=0}^{e_i-2}q^a z^a]-1). Rank<=R equivalent to bounded height sum; every smaller bounded vector extends to one with total R-2, and incomparable upper bounds produce all irreducible linear components. Independent direct Gram-matrix finite-field elimination and all coefficient-vector enumeration for multiple F2/F3 examples, including (2,3,3), reproduced exact histograms and membership.

value.rationale: For a natural multi-branch Artin algebra with no nondegenerate associative pairing, the exact rank distribution and complete reduced degeneracy arrangement are intrinsic invariants of its multiplication tensor. The uniform all-branch, all-exponent, all-characteristic formulas and generic radical size are independently useful for degeneracy and finite-field geometry; this is more than the known elementary B_f=f(uv) correspondence.

final_claim: For any field k and a coordinate-cross Artin algebra fiber-product A=k[x_1,...,x_t]/(x_ix_j for i!=j, x_i^{e_i}) with t>=2, e_i>=2, every associative symmetric form B_f(u,v)=f(uv) has rank 0/1 with all positive coefficients zero, or rank 2+sum_{h_i>0}(h_i-1), where h_i is maximal nonzero degree on branch i. An explicit q-polynomial enumerates every rank and the rank<=R reduced loci are precisely linear spaces indexed by bounded height compositions, with dimension t+R-1 and exact component count.
limitations: Reduced rank loci only; nonreduced determinantal scheme multiplicities and form isometry/orbits not classified.
